On you multi-targeting move, go to your damage formula and divide damage dealt by the number of present enemies.
In MV/MZ, it's either
Code:

or
Code:

posts.author: Another Fen
posts.body:
Are you mainly looking to implement a specific solution here or are you looking for general ideas as to why your protagonist(s) would not want/be able to AoE that bosses clones?
If it is the latter, maybe a few suggestions:
- You could make the boss also immune to AoE damage.
One way to achieve this would be to use different elements for single- and multi target skills.
Another would be to create a new "AoE damage rate" element and put it into your AoE skills damage formulas:
(original formula) * b.elementRate(17)
- You could make the clones vulnerable to AoE skills, but immune to death (State Resist: Death), so the player cannot tell which damage actually mattered.
- You could make the boss curse the party and apply a state that "Seal Skill"s every AoE ability.
(Keep in mind that by default that state is cured if a battler dies and is revived)
- You could make the boss spawn an extra "red barrel" enemy that explodes in the partys face when hit.
(You could use a battle event that checks if the barrel falls to 99% HP to trigger this)

If you like the approach, you could maybe modify the event to only do the retaliation bit if multiple clones are missing HP.
Late Edit
: Since you mentioned you are using the STB, which I would assume means VisuStellas STB? Anyways, if you are using VisuStellas Battle Core (or a similar plugin), you could also use a note tag on your clone enemy to check the type of skill they were hit with:
Code:
<JS post-apply as target>
  if (b.result().isHit()) {  // if Hit was a success...
    if (!this.isForOne()) {  // and if Attack was not single-target...
      $gameSwitches.setValue(17, true);  // turn Switch 17 ON
    }
  }
</JS post-apply as target>
(I have not yet tested the script; there is a chance that the second code line does not work)
